entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabriel da Silva Dias, commonly known as Gabriel, is a Brazilian former futsal player who played for Barcelona and Inter Movistar as a flank. In his career, he won the UEFA Futsal Champions League four times, the FIFA Futsal World Cup two times and a gold medal in Futsal at the 2007 Pan American Games.
